svg.title: What is next, and what we need from the community
svg.desc: Next steps: fix the slot-growth warning, and ask whether a content policy is wanted. The open question for the room: would a rule that stops a job on a forbidden data change be useful on your database?

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHAT IS NEXT

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What is next

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Fix what we already found

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make the operator warn when the slot keeps

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: growing, not only when it hits a size cap.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Real, in the product today, independent of

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: everything below. This one we just do.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Validate the direction

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Content policies are the real product, but

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: we do NOT yet know if anyone wants them.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Attribution (the “who”) is expensive, so a

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: policy must be useful on the “what” alone.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Would this be useful on your database?

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: “A settled payment must never go back to pending.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If it does, stop the job and alert.”

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: honest answer: we don't know yet

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: And: is your Postgres self-operated or managed? Do you need to know WHICH workload did it, or is WHAT changed enough?

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lactifluus — CDC observability on Kubernetes
